text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Sprinters Stakes had finally arrived,
marking Curren Chan's second time running in it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That day, Nakayama Racecourse was buzzing with excitement
unlike anything seen before—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: —Oh, they said a special pre-race video is gonna play on the screen!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Quiet down, everyone!
It's about to start~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"Buono, everyone♪
Today's dish is—"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"No!
This is where you talk about your enthusiasm for the race!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
""Oh, that's right♪
Um, we sure have a lot of guests today!""

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"Uooooooooh!
Do your best, everyone!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, sank kyuu!
Sank kyuu♪"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Seeing so many, many people
gather here today...
makes me super happy♪"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"Yup!
Whether it's your voice or anything else,
bigger is always better♪"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: "So basically~... Today's biggest me is gonna win the race—"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"STOOOOP!
I won't let you say another word!! Not while I am class representative――"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Yes!
'Cause I'm just as big as they are!
So that means I'm gonna win, see?♪"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: "Nuwaaaaaah!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
""I was the one!
Who wanted to take the lead!!""

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"Ahaha~.
I'm gonna win too~♪"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"Haaah!
I'm going to win too~~!!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Ahaha~, things are heating up♪
And with that,
the Sprinters Stakes is about to begin!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"With so many people watching us,
we're having tons of fun♪"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: "Everyone at the racetrack, and everyone watching the stream too..."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: "Curren is gonna steal everyone's hearts today♪"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"‘Ah! *Twiii-eet*!
No jumping the gun!’"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Aha, you found me out!
Well then—"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: "I'll be waiting for lots of cheers!♪"

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh...!
Now I'm getting excited!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! As expected, the center of attention today
is the one who came up with the idea, Curren Chan.
I can't wait to see how this matchup turns out!

text_block_list.name: Curren Follower
text_block_list.text:
Cute Curren Chan!
Cute Curren Chan!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
What is this...? The hype is on par with the Arima Kinen.
What on earth is going—

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
"You don't know, mister? Well then...
Try searching for 'Kawaii Derby♪'!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text: “Cute Derby♪”...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Click, tap... click)

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Wh... Th-This is...!
This is—

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text: SO CUUUUUUUTE!!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
...Incredible.
I can hear the cheers all the way over here.
choice_data_list: That's the power of the 'Kawaii Derby♪'.
That's the power of the 'Kawaii Derby♪', huh?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
“I see... Yeah, you're right.
Just as Curren planned... No, even better.”

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
—Anticipation is at its peak. The lineup is stellar.
The grand, shining stage is set to perfection...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"All that's left is for Curren
to be the most loved girl of all today..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Curren Chan seemed unusually nervous.
And for good reason.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today, we will find out if everything she...
no, everything *we* have done up until now was right.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Big Brother.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Big Sister.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I only want to ask one thing.
Is today's Curren...—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: —Ehehe... Yep, perfect♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Curren's off!
I'll deliver cuteness to everyone!
